explication: Comp AI CRM is an agent-first customer relationship platform. A user works in the Next.js CRM, whose requests pass through the API to authenticated CRM records, conversations, search, enrichment, and dashboards. Independently, scheduled agent sessions lease due work, inspect CRM evidence and optional external sources, then record facts or schedule follow-ups. Tracking and mailbox synchronization provide additional signals. The tree and README establish these boundaries; several internal service-to-service links remain intentionally conservative because their implementations were not sampled.
